content: {"like":["Values strong, original ideas and high-quality visuals; appreciates well-crafted performances and creative direction (e.g., Brad Bird); enjoys unique, visually stunning animation and storytelling that feels fresh and artistic; prefers clear, straightforward plots with deep character development; seeks films that balance humor, depth, and engaging action."],"dislike":["Dislikes cluttered, overcomplicated narratives with too many characters or plot twists; rejects poorly executed adaptations or reworks that feel forced or comedic in unintended ways; avoids films with immature or subpar acting, especially involving children; dislikes excessive reliance on explosions, robots, or generic fantasy tropes; shuns endings that undermine earlier depth or humor."]}
